terrain: Production game asset: ONE square terrain texture atlas for AsteraCraft RTS, exactly 4 columns by 4 rows of 16 equal square edge-to-edge material tiles, no gutters, no borders, no text. Original hand-painted realistic late-1990s prerendered RTS terrain aesthetic, detailed like StarCraft but original assets. Orthographic overhead materials with consistent soft upper-left lighting, not a landscape scene. Planet theme temperate barren battlefield: muted brown ochre dirt, grey sedimentary rock and olive moss. Row1: four different seamless-packed gritty earth textures with pebbles, fissures and compact soil. Row2: four distinct worn sandstone pavement textures / rocky plateau tops / sparse mossy stone / gravel. Row3: four textures: eroded layered cliff face material, dark jagged basalt face material, water with muddy shallow ripples, deep blue water. Row4: four fine-detail topdown surfaces: cracked dry mud, worn ancient stone paving, scattered tiny shale chips, dirt with sparse grass roots. All tiles occupy their entire square, all consistent natural scale, crisp details readable when downsampled to a 128px tile. No giant boulders, no buildings, no units, no perspective scene, no drop shadows or beveled tile borders. 2048x2048 atlas.

diamonds: Create an exact GAME TILESET SPRITE ATLAS for an original science-fiction RTS with the visual language of the 1998 StarCraft Badlands map editor terrain. Image 2048 by 1024 pixels, exactly 4 columns x 4 rows, each cell 512 wide x 256 high. Every cell contains ONE FLAT 2:1 isometric diamond ground tile, filling the whole cell from top-midpoint to right-midpoint to bottom-midpoint to left-midpoint; corners outside diamond fully transparent. NO thick slab, NO floating island, NO vertical side faces, NO outline, NO bevel, NO drop shadow. Tiles must tile together as continuous flat ground when staggered. Crisp prerendered pixel-art detail, tightly controlled earthy palette, tiny fine-grained grit, not blurry photography, no giant boulders, no huge cracked slabs. Row1: four matching variations of dry medium-brown compact earth, fine pebble grain and small organic cracks, subtle variation. Row2: four matching rocky dirt variations, grey-brown gravel, tiny embedded shale, darker trampled soil, faded dust. Row3: four variations of dirt with sparse olive grasses and tiny worn debris, original RTS battlefield ground. Row4: four worn sandstone paving and compressed earth variants, same muted earthy palette, geometric diagonals subtly aligned to diamond edges. All 16 same lighting upper-left, same ground plane, same scale, thin flat diamond silhouettes, entirely original assets. Natural tile edge shades should match so no black seams. True transparent background outside each diamond, no labels.

movement: A production-ready transparent RTS game visual-effects sprite sheet, exactly 8 columns and 3 rows of equal square cells (24 sprites), no text, no grid, no opaque background. Each row is a coherent 8-frame seamless looping animation with all sprites centered in their cells, generous transparent padding. Row 1: small blue-white jet engine exhaust, flame points downward, origin fixed at top-center, flickering short tapered ion plume with orange rim, animated shape distinctly changes across 8 phases. Row 2: green-gold organic propulsion pollen wisps, downward trailing, soft tiny glowing spores, same looping phases. Row 3: crimson magical propulsion energy, narrow downward flame with gold sparks, successive flickering loop phases. Original painted prerendered late 1990s science fiction RTS effect style. Only effect sprites, no ships, no units, no rings or circles behind them. Fixed emitter location, maximum effect occupies central 65% of each cell. True transparent alpha background. 2048x768.
